comment: Pinned Node runtime for the sidecar, the ONE place it is defined. Consumers: tauri/scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs (desktop externalBin) and lib/local-serve/bootstrap-sh.ts (the curl-distributed serve.sh). LTS; node:sqlite needs no flag since 23.4, so hostFloorMajor gates which host Node may run the bundle without downloading this one. Official Node 24 binaries need macOS >= 13.5 — bundle.macOS.minimumSystemVersion in tauri.conf.json must stay at or above this Node's floor or the sidecar dies silently on old Macs. sha256 values are from https://nodejs.org/dist/v<version>/SHASUMS256.txt; bumping version means re-pinning them.
